---
title: The Salt Road
order: 1
date: "1915"
---

The salt road ran from Qarim to Saltmere across the dunes, and Kadir had walked it more times than he could count.

That spring the caravan was small: six camels, a cook who sang badly, and a sealed letter for the court at Saltmere. Kadir carried the letter inside his coat and did not ask what it said.

On the third night the old cook told the story of the court poisoner while the fire burned down. Orsan the Grey was born in 1745, the cook said, in a tent at the edge of the Shifting Sands, and he served three salt kings before the last one stopped trusting him.

Kadir listened, and said nothing, and in the morning he walked on towards Saltmere.
